title: StutterStigma-TR: A Novel Turkish Dataset and Target-Aware BERT Framework for Stuttering-Related Stigma Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.30252v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Computational research on disability-related ableist harm remains limited, and condition specific resources for stuttering-related stigma are particularly scarce. This study introduces StutterStigma-TR, a Turkish dataset of 6,019 public X/Twitter posts annotated as Stigmatizing, Non-stigmatizing/contextual, or Supportive using a speech and language therapy-informed protocol with independent lived-experience evaluation. We also propose StutterStigma-BERT, a BERTurk-based target-aware framework that combines explicit target marking, target-span representation, target-conditioned context, character-level and handcrafted orthographic information, and gated discourse cues. translated_title: StutterStigma-TR：一个新颖的土耳其语数据集与目标感知BERT框架，用于口吃相关污名化言论检测
translated_abstract: 关于残疾相关能力主义伤害的计算研究仍然有限，而针对口吃相关污名化的特定领域资源尤为稀缺。本研究介绍了StutterStigma-TR，这是一个包含6,019条公开X/Twitter帖子的土耳其语数据集，采用基于言语语言治疗专业知识的标注协议，将这些帖子标注为“污名化”、“非污名化/语境性”或“支持性”三类，并进行了独立的生活经验评估。我们还提出了StutterStigma-BERT，这是一个基于BERTurk的目标感知框架，结合了显式目标标记、目标跨度表示、目标条件化上下文、字符级与手工构建的正字法信息，以及门控话语线索。该框架在互补的三分类和二分类设置下进行评估，采用受控的三种子消融分析和最终的20种子鲁棒性评估。在通用训练协议下，使用交叉熵训练的Gated Discourse-OrthoTarget模型被选为最终方案。
tldr: 本文提出了首个土耳其语口吃污名化检测数据集StutterStigma-TR（含6,019条社交媒体帖子），并设计了基于BERTurk的目标感知框架StutterStigma-BERT，通过显式目标标记与多维度特征融合显著提升了口吃相关污名化言论的检测效果。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces StutterStigma-TR, a novel Turkish dataset of 6,019 social media posts for stuttering-related stigma detection, along with StutterStigma-BERT, a target-aware BERTurk framework that combines explicit target marking and multi-dimensional features to significantly improve detection performance.
